name: @ayar/probe
description: AYAR's web probe (C-14): pages rendered in Playwright's Chromium — the declared states at their viewports, themes and languages, axe, computed styles, fonts, direction, images and timings, with every request kept on this machine — and the judges that turn what it saw into findings. The browser driver runs in a process of its own (E-11); the engine imports the contract and the judges only.
